notes.title: Update notes 22/02/2024
notes.content:
Updated open world level with more foliage/environmental aesthetics
Added enemies to open world - these will be patrolling the wilderness
Updated server to fix instability issues
Updated main menu to include host game/server list so players can create private lobbies
Added more dynamic foliage
Added Hydra eggs to western cave in the open world
Added Fire and Ice Wyvern eggs to different locations in open world

notes.title: Patch Notes 11/02/2024
notes.content: Added new open world cave dungeon

notes.title: Patch notes 09/02/2024
notes.content:
[olist]
Added Eggs around the map that can be picked up and incubated
Added Nest at castle for egg incubation, can also be built using blueprint
Added maturity growth to newly hatched creatures
Added imprinting of baby creatures, this sets the creatures owner, only the owner can perform commands/mount the imprinted creature. 
Press H to summon creature
[/olist]

notes.title: Patch notes for 05/02/2024
notes.content:
Implemented Map, MiniMap and Compass to UI
Added Quest management

notes.title: Patch notes 31/01/2024
notes.content:
Updated dedicated server map 
 Fixed choppable trees  
 Added mounts 
 Updated Main Menu to simplify - Now shows "Join Open World" - from the open world you can create Arena games / PVE Dungeons 
 Fixed issues with character loading/saving 
 Added flying mounts 
 Added snow biome to high mountain tops 
 Added minable resources (stone/iron) 
 Added gatherable resources to open world map 
 Fixed issue in dedicated server not showing correct player count 


Coming Soon...

 Taming - using bait players can tame any creature they encounter. Different baits are used depending on the creature - predator / prey. Tamed creatures can be used to guard/attack/harvest resources - more info coming soon. 
 More open world content - including enemy NPC's, Raiding NPC's and more animals to the eco system

notes.title: Update notes 21/01/2024
notes.content:
New open world dedicated server online. Open world map is a real world heightmap of southern most point of Cornwall, UK. This map will be fleshed out over the coming days/weeks to include animal eco system, NPC helpers, dungeons, NPC hideouts, Open world PVP arena's and much more.
 PCG generated foliage, tree's, rocks added

notes.title: Updates Notes for 18/01/2024
notes.content:
Added Chickens to Lobby level village
 Added Cats to Lobby level village
 Added Cats to Lobby level - can be found in the winter zones.
 Character animations changed for duel wield weapons.

notes.title: Live stream to quickly demonstrate new patch
notes.content: Live stream to quickly demonstrate new patch, see previous update for patch notes and updates.

notes.title: Update notes for 17/01/2024
notes.content:
[olist]
 Added new eco-system animals; Leopards, these can be found in the Woodlands, located north-east of the village, be careful, they're fast and will chase you until your legs give out. Elephants can be found within the snowy mountain ranges and hit hard so don't get too close as they're territorial and aggressive
 Optimised more foliage to better increase stability and FPS. 
[/olist]

notes.title: Bug fixes and openworld expansion
notes.content:
The following bugs and alterations have been made.


 Bug when loading character data
 Updated animations for dual wield weapons

 Added Werewolf spawner to openworld level
